text:
The panel's reasoning consistently supports a scheduled end-to-end travel time of 23 minutes between Orrinford Junction and Tarnside Park, with trains running every 6 minutes at peak. Five of six panelists agreed on the 23-minute figure, treating the single 29-minute outlier as a misreading.

Answer: 23 minutes end-to-end; trains every 6 minutes at peak.

Dredging will deepen the berth pocket to 17.8 metres (from 14.5 metres), and the terminal's annual capacity after expansion will be 2.1 million TEU.

Answer: 17.8 metres; 2.1 million TEU per year.

The three-phase expansion programme lays 12.4 km in Phase 1, 8.7 km in Phase 2, and 15.6 km in Phase 3, giving a total of 36.7 km of new pipe.

Answer: 36.7 kilometres

The tunnel's original public opening date was 14 September 2026. An announced delay of 11 weeks (77 days) pushes the opening to 30 November 2026, which all panelists confirmed through consistent arithmetic and a weekday check.

Answer: 30 November 2026

Mean systolic blood pressure fell by 13.6 mmHg in the tirnapexil arm at week 16, and 19 tirnapexil participants had hyperkalaemia.

Answer: 13.6 mmHg; 19 participants.

All panelists agree that the placebo group's FVC declined by 171 mL over 52 weeks. The most common adverse event was diarrhoea, reported in 22% of olvemarin participants.

Answer: FVC declined by 171 mL over 52 weeks in the placebo group; the most common adverse event was diarrhoea.

In the senotrazide arm, 54 of 450 participants discontinued the study drug before day 3. This gives 54 ÷ 450 = 0.12, or 12%.

Answer: 12%

All panelists agree: of 312 participants randomized to the pelvastrin arm, 27 withdrew consent, 14 were lost to follow-up, and 19 died before month 24, totaling 60 non-completers. All remaining participants completed follow-up. Thus, 312 − 60 = 252.

Answer: 252

Corvane Logistics' year-end order backlog was $386 million, and the company guided fiscal 2026 revenue growth of 6% to 8%.

Answer: $386 million backlog; 6%–8% revenue growth guidance.

Five of six panelists agree that Ostrel Savings Bank's year-end CET1 ratio was 14.3%, and all six agree its net interest margin for 2025 was 2.17%. The lone dissenting figure of 12.7% is treated as inconsistent with the evidence.

Answer: CET1 ratio: 14.3%; net interest margin: 2.17%.

Brightfen Foods' net sales grew from $250 million in fiscal 2024 to $295 million in fiscal 2025, an increase of $45 million. Dividing by the fiscal 2024 base ($45M ÷ $250M) yields 18% growth.

Answer: 18%

Tamberlin defines free cash flow as operating cash flow minus capital expenditures. For fiscal 2025, operating cash flow was $87.3 million and capital expenditures were $52.9 million, yielding $34.4 million. Share repurchases are excluded from the company's definition.

Answer: $34.4 million

The panel's reasoning overwhelmingly supports that the jury awarded $1.64 million in compensatory damages and did not award punitive damages. Five of six panelists confirmed this figure, with the single outlier of $2.14 million dismissed as a likely misreading.

Answer: The jury awarded $1.64 million in compensatory damages and did not award punitive damages.

All panelists agree that the contractual cap on Solgrave's total liability was 7.5 million euros, and the tribunal awarded Ventrica 6.9 million euros. The award fell below the cap.

Answer: The contractual cap was €7.5 million; the tribunal awarded Ventrica €6.9 million.

The settlement agreement's effective date is 18 February 2025 (E2). Payment into the tenant compensation fund is due no later than 45 calendar days after that date, with 19 February counted as day 1 (E3). Counting forward: 19–28 February gives days 1–10; March gives days 11–41; 1–4 April gives days 42–45. The deadline is therefore 4 April 2025.

Answer: 4 April 2025

The panel unanimously concludes the defendant was ordered to pay $2.35 million in compensatory damages (already reduced for contributory negligence), $0.41 million in prejudgment interest, and $0.12 million in taxable costs. Legal fees were excluded as non-recoverable. The sum is $2.88 million.

Answer: $2.88 million

The panel unanimously agrees that the tephra layer was dated to 4,270 years before present and was found at a depth of 3.8 metres in the core. One outlier reading of 3,740 years was dismissed as unsupported.

Answer: 4,270 years before present, at a depth of 3.8 metres.

The panel reached strong consensus: LXP-9 exhibited a room-temperature ionic conductivity of 0.84 mS/cm, and test cells retained 88% of their initial capacity after 500 cycles. One outlier value of 0.58 mS/cm was rejected by the majority.

Answer: 0.84 mS/cm ionic conductivity; 88% capacity retention after 500 cycles.

The Tarnveld Glacier terminus retreated 384 metres between the 2008 and 2024 surveys, a span of 16 years. Dividing 384 m by 16 years yields an average terminus retreat rate of 24 metres per year.

Answer: 24 metres per year

The 2015 census recorded 1,480 breeding pairs and the 2025 census recorded 1,110. The decline of 370 pairs represents a 25% decrease relative to the 2015 baseline.

Answer: 25%

All panelists unanimously agree that 48,600 patients' records were exposed, and the attacker first gained access on 29 July 2025. The 12 August 2025 date was the detection date, not the initial access date.

Answer: 48,600 patients' records were exposed; the attacker first gained access on 29 July 2025.

The panel unanimously concluded that an estimated 340 kilograms of ammonia was released before the refrigeration line was isolated, and 3 workers were admitted to hospital overnight.

Answer: 340 kilograms of ammonia was released, and 3 workers were admitted to hospital overnight.

The outage lasted 4 hours and 25 minutes, from the first errors at 22:47 UTC on 9 October to the recorded end at 03:12 UTC on 10 October.

Answer: 4 hours and 25 minutes

The incident lasted 35 minutes with 1,200 checkout attempts per minute, yielding 42,000 total attempts. At a 30% failure rate, 12,600 checkout attempts failed.

Answer: 12,600
